title: Walden
author: Henry David Thoreau
description: Two years in a cabin by a Massachusetts pond, and what living simply taught the man who built it.
quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach.

title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
description: Mole, Rat, Badger and the reckless Mr Toad along a quiet English riverbank.
quote: There is nothing, absolutely nothing, half so much worth doing as simply messing about in boats.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
description: A talkative, imaginative orphan is sent by mistake to a brother and sister on Prince Edward Island.
quote: I'm so glad I live in a world where there are Octobers.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
description: Four sisters grow up, quarrel and find their own paths in Civil War New England.
quote: I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess falls for her employer and discovers the secret in his house.
quote: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me: I am a free human being with an independent will.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
description: A lonely girl sent to a Yorkshire manor finds a locked garden and brings it, and the house, back to life.
quote: If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: A girl follows a white rabbit down a hole into a world where nothing behaves as it should.
quote: It's no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr Darcy in a comedy of manners and misjudgement.
quote: Think only of the past as its remembrance gives you pleasure.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties in pursuit of a lost love.
quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man stays untouched by time while his portrait takes on every mark of the life he leads.
quote: The only way to get rid of a temptation is to yield to it.

title: Three Men in a Boat
author: Jerome K. Jerome
description: Three friends and a dog take a rowing holiday up the Thames, and very little goes to plan.
quote: I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
description: A clever, confident young woman sets about arranging her neighbours' love lives and misreads nearly all of them.
quote: One half of the world cannot understand the pleasures of the other.
